verdict.rationale: Morph documents an OpenAI-compatible base URL (`https://api.morphllm.com/v1`), chat completions, and `/v1/messages`, and says models are selected by passing a `model` string. Nothing in the pack documents a GET /v1/models or other model-listing endpoint, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. General OpenAI-SDK compatibility is an adjacent claim and does not establish a live catalog endpoint.
